result.title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
result.summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpecLook，一个免训练的三级「推测—验证」框架：小模型先起草下一步 glimpse 并据此重答，答案不变且自信则提前结束；否则由大模型无工具地验证并修正该 glimpse、融合答案；仍缺证据的问题才进入 agent 前向，并从轨迹中免标注地给出答案可靠性分数。在 V*、HR-Bench、POPE 上报告更高准确率与 4.7–9.9 倍加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接处理 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡与视觉证据筛选：把「下一步看哪里」作为可验证、可纠正的中间假设来替代答案推测，并提供无标签可靠性估计，与关注点高度重合；其 glimpse 推测究竟对应像素级证据还是内部状态表示，可供核查。
